from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib
w=str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py')

 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0

receipts=[]
for p in sorted(Path('.').glob('*.receipt.json')):
 o=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'path':p.name,'exit':o.get('exit'),'killed':o.get('killed'),'wall_s':o.get('wall_s'),'child_cpu_cumulative_s':o.get('child_cpu_cumulative_s'),'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':o.get('sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes')})

print('Inventoried',len(sources),'source artifacts',len(receipts),'completed receipts; failed exits',[(r['path'],r['exit']) for r in receipts if r['exit']])
